title: Best Time to Visit Cres, Croatia: Seasonal Guide 2027
metaDescription: Late May–June and September are the best times to visit Cres, Croatia, balancing warm sea, lighter crowds and lower prices. Ferry costs and seasonal tips.
content:
## When Is the Best Time to Visit Cres?

Late May to June and September give the best balance of weather, crowds and price on Cres. Summer air temperatures average about 24°C, and the sea averages roughly 22°C in the warm months. July and August are warmer and busier, and cost the most. Winter is quiet but most tourist services close.

The verdict for most travelers: **book the second half of June or the first three weeks of September.** Both periods offer swimmable water, open restaurants, and a full ferry schedule without peak-season pricing.

## Seasonal Verdict at a Glance

| Season | Weather | Crowds | Price | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spring (April–mid-May) | Mild, cool sea | Very low | Lowest | Best for hiking and cycling |
| Early summer (late May–June) | Warm, sunny | Moderate | Mid-range | Best overall |
| Peak summer (July–August) | Hottest, sea about 25°C | Highest | Highest | Good for beaches, poor for value |
| Early autumn (September) | Warm, sea about 22–23°C | Moderate to low | Falling | Best for swimming on a budget |
| Late autumn–winter (October–March) | Cool, wettest period | Minimal | Low | Only for quiet stays |

## Why Late May–June Works Best

Daytime temperatures of roughly 22–26°C suit hiking, cycling and town visits. The sea is still cool in early June, so swimming is better in the second half of the month. Rentals and rooms cost noticeably less than in July. Private apartments, the most common accommodation type on the island, range from about €40 to €120 per night depending on dates. Direct-from-owner listings in Cres Town and Martinšćica start around €44–60 per night for shoulder-season stays.

## Why September Is the Best Month for Swimmers

The sea holds its summer heat into September at about 22–23°C, while air temperatures drop to a comfortable 20–25°C. Pricing follows the calendar. One sea-view apartment in Cres Town, for example, drops from €656 per week in early September to €525 in mid-September and €438 from late September. Autumn is also the wetter season on Cres, so check the forecast for rain, and bora wind days can affect ferries.

## Is July and August Worth It?

Only if school holidays fix your dates or you want the warmest sea. Hotel prices on the island average about €260 per night in June–August, compared with about €111 in the cheapest season. The ferry is the main bottleneck. Treat Valbiska as you would an airport in peak weeks: arrive early, buy tickets ahead if possible, and avoid planning around one specific sailing.

Skip the peak weeks of mid-August unless you have booked accommodation months ahead. On an island with few hotels and limited parking in Cres Town, the extra heat and queues rarely justify the premium.

## Spring and Winter: Who They Suit

April and May suit hikers and cyclists. Blooming landscapes and mild air are the draw, but sea temperatures stay around 13–17°C. From November to March, many establishments close, ferry service is reduced, and weather is cooler and rainy. Winter visits suit people who want empty roads and quiet villages, not beach holidays.

## Getting There: Ferry Costs and Timing

Cres has two ferry links to the mainland, both run by Jadrolinija:

- **Valbiska (Krk) to Merag (Cres):** 25 minutes, line 332. The same price applies all year, with extra sailings from early July to the end of September.
- **Brestova (Istria) to Porozina (Cres):** 20 minutes, line 334. This is the entry point from Istria and Trieste.

The 2026 public tariff is €4.40 per adult passenger, €2.20 for children aged 3–12, and €20.70 for a standard car up to 5 m. Check the current Jadrolinija tariff for 2027 before travel. Krk is reached by a bridge that has been free since June 2020, so a car trip from Zagreb or Rijeka needs only the Cres ferry fare.

## Local Tips for Timing a Trip

- **Pick the northern or southern half by season.** The south is lower and more sheltered, with a Mediterranean climate, so it feels milder early and late in the year. The north is greener and cooler.
- **Plan around wind.** Bora (northeast), sirocco (south) and mistral (northwest) all affect the island. Bora is the one that can disrupt ferries, so keep a day spare on return trips.
- **Camp early or late.** Campsites near Cres Town and in Martinšćica and Valun offer cheaper pitches and quieter beaches outside July and August.
- **Combine with Lošinj.** Cres connects to Lošinj by a short bridge at Osor, so the two islands can be done together in one trip, with the best weather windows the same as above.

## Quick Planning Rules

1. Want swimming and fair prices: choose September.
2. Want hiking and cheap rooms: choose late April to May.
3. Want the warmest sea and lively evenings: choose July, but book early.
4. Want a quiet, low-cost stay with few services: choose November to March, and confirm opening before you go.

faq.question: What is the best month to visit Cres, Croatia?
faq.answer: September is the best single month for most travelers. The sea is about 22–23°C, the air is comfortable at 20–25°C, and prices drop as the month goes on. Late June is the best alternative.

faq.question: Is Cres worth visiting in July and August?
faq.answer: Yes, if you want the warmest sea (about 25°C) and the fullest local life. It is also the most expensive and crowded period, with hotel averages near €260 per night and heavier ferry traffic.

faq.question: Can you swim in Cres in May?
faq.answer: Only briefly for most people. Sea temperatures are around 17°C in May, which is cool. Reliable swimming starts in the second half of June.

faq.question: How much is the ferry to Cres?
faq.answer: On the 2026 tariff, a passenger pays €4.40 and a standard car costs €20.70 on both the Valbiska–Merag and Brestova–Porozina routes. Crossings take 25 and 20 minutes. Check Jadrolinija for 2027 prices.

faq.question: Is Cres open in winter?
faq.answer: Partly. Many restaurants, rental owners and tourist services close between November and March, and ferry service is more limited. Cres Town stays inhabited, but options are few.

faq.question: When is the cheapest time to visit Cres?
faq.answer: Spring, from March to May, has the lowest hotel averages at about €111–132 per night. The trade-off is cold sea water and some businesses not yet open. Late September also gives good savings with warmer water.

quickAnswer: The best time to visit Cres is late May to June, or September. Air temperatures sit around 22–26°C, the sea reaches roughly 22–23°C by late June and September, crowds are lighter than in July–August, and accommodation costs far less than at the peak. Avoid November to March, when many businesses close.
